messages:
Clare (CS): Morning — quick weekly pulse for the Valora onboarding account. sending W/W + QoQ headline numbers and a couple of flags.
Clare (CS): Tokens (7d avg): 420.2k -> 386.1k (-8.1% W/W). QoQ: +14% vs last quarter.
Clare (CS): Throughput: avg RPS down 9%, concurrency steady. Notable: p95 latency climbed 120ms -> 168ms yesterday evening.
Clare (CS): Error rate: 0.6% -> 1.3% (transient spike around 02:10-02:45 UTC). Spend: $18.2k -> $20.0k (+9.9% W/W). Expected due to longer tail latencies.
Tom (SRE): seeing the same in infra metrics — a host in us-west had GPU warmup jitter, KV cache misses jumped ~14% at 02:12 UTC.
Mike (Eng): Can you paste the request patterns? small-batch traffic or sudden large prompts?
Clare (CS): mostly steady, startup tests earlier increased seq len (avg token/req up from 75 -> 120 for a 30-min window). I suspect batching inefficiency + cold KV shards.
Tom (SRE): confirmed: 3 of 9 pods had cache TTL evictions, kernel logs show a few out-of-memory recoveries around that time.
Mike (Eng): ok — action: I'll push a quick patch to increase KV prewarm on new pods and bump batching window for that model. Will monitor.
Ana (AM): flagged to Valora — asked them to avoid long-burst synthetic tests during business hours. They run scheduled integration tests at 02:00 UTC; I asked for a 1hr shift.
Clare (CS): next steps: 1) Mike to deploy prewarm patch (in-flight), 2) Tom to pin pods to older config for immediate mitigation, 3) Ana to confirm test time change with Valora, 4) I'll follow up on spend impact.
Tom (SRE): deploying rollback/pin now. ETA 12m. Will report once stable.
Mike (Eng): patch deployed to staging; promoting to canary now -> route 5% of traffic. Keeping batching window +20ms.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary promotion started for release r-2026-03-20-clarify-kw (canary 5%).
Tom (SRE): canary looks OK so far — p95 improving in canary pods: 170ms -> 128ms.
Clare (CS): good signal. If canary stays stable for 30m we promote. Also note QoQ token growth still positive — mention in renewal deck: usage has healthy seasonality but short-term spikes can drive spend.
Ana (AM): I added a short note to renewal slide 4 about QoQ momentum and the guardrails we've activated. Will sync with Clare after promotion.
Clare (CS): thanks team. I'll update Valora after promotion; re-open thread if anything else pops up.
Tom (SRE): stable promote done. All pods on pinned config + prewarm. p95 now ~122ms. Error rate dropping to 0.4%.
Clare (CS): final: weekly summary for docs repo: Tokens W/W -8.1%, Spend +9.9% (transient), p95 latency improved post-fix from 168ms -> 122ms, error rate normalized. ACTIONS: follow-up in 48h to confirm sustained QoS.
Ana (AM): noted. I'll confirm schedule change with customer and book a short enablement call next week.
Clare (CS): :thumbsup: thanks everyone.
